newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, near contract lows.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, near contract lows.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower and near contract lows amid overall export-related weakness in U.S. wheat markets, traders said.
But spring wheat futures did not lose as much ground as their counterparts in Kansas City or Chicago thanks to steady scale-down buying by mills and commercials.
"Our market continued to consolidate in a tight range, although mill and export pricing support helped underpin us," a trader said.
Traders reported having seen more overhead selling show up as Minneapolis wheat firmed relative to other markets.
MGE spring wheat closed 3/4 to four cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 3/4 cents at $4.09-1/2. March lost 3/4 cents lower at $3.96-3/4 -- near the contract low of 3.96-1/4.
Unlike in Kansas City and Chicago, where the Dec/March spread narrowed, the MGE spring wheat spread widened, trading from around 10 cents early to 12 bid/13 offered late.
Continental bought 800,000 Dec bushels. LFG sold 600,000 each of Dec and March, traders said.
MGE barley closed steady to 19 cents per cwt higher, with Dec up 19 cents at $6.77.
